title: ما أصبح / أمسى بي من نعمة

timingCountsBenefits: Morning/evening gratitude; fulfilling the day/night gratitude claim withheld.
alternativeDecision: Existing authentic gratitude/other timed supplications are not new entries.

title: العافية في البدن والسمع والبصر

grading: Hasan in chain: al-Albani. Arnaut also records Hasan with corroboration; not relabeled Sahih.
timingCountsBenefits: Three morning/evening; bodily/hearing/sight wellbeing and the associated refuge text. Supplication is not a medical guarantee.
alternativeDecision: Abu Dawud 5074 wellbeing is already included; no duplicate.

title: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو
narrator: Abu al-Darda; attribution/chain requires separate review
grading: Al-Albani labels this report Mawdu. Other discussions of a companion chain do not resolve Prophetic attribution or the sevenfold benefit. This judgment is NOT against Quran 9:129.
timingCountsBenefits: Seven morning/evening and sufficiency promise not admitted. No Quran text is assigned an unsupported reward.
alternativeDecision: No distinct authenticated timed substitute established in this audit.

title: رضيت بالله ربًا

timingCountsBenefits: Morning/evening threefold practice withheld; general satisfaction with Allah/Islam/Muhammad is a different context.
alternativeDecision: General Sahih wording not imported as a new prescribed morning/evening routine.

narrator: Ubayy ibn Kab in Ahmad Zawaid 21144; morning reports also from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza
grading: Arnaut: Sahih for the evening extension; al-Albani: very weak chain for this route (al-Silsilah al-Sahihah 6/1233 discussion). Resolve route and wording before admission.
timingCountsBenefits: Evening extension وإذا أمسينا مثل ذلك is disputed separately from established morning text.
alternativeDecision: Morning fitrah remains unchanged; no invented evening adaptation.

title: لا إله إلا الله الواحد القهار
grading: Al-Albani: Sahih (Sahih al-Jami 4693); Ibn Hajar: معلول (Ithaf 17/320). Material unresolved disagreement, not a Bukhari report.
timingCountsBenefits: Turning/restlessness during the night, not an unconditional before-bed routine.
alternativeDecision: Distinct alternative: sleep_night_waking, Bukhari 1154; no assertion that the original is verified.

title: دعاء الفزع في النوم
narrator: Abdullah ibn Amr, through Amr ibn Shuayb from his father
grading: Hasan: al-Albani, excluding the companion amulet passage. Hasan is insufficient here; wording variants must not be blended.
timingCountsBenefits: Fear during sleep; no numerical prescription admitted.
alternativeDecision: Distinct bedtime alternative: sleep_creator, Abu Dawud 5067. Not a fear-specific supplication; existing Sahih bad-dream guidance remains.
